short: Total electron momentum between walk steps

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.stoppingPowerProgram
lean.plain: Circuit for evolution to t = j + 1
lean.annotation: In an electron–electron term the transfers $+\nu$ and $-\nu$ cancel in the total electron momentum. Electron–proton and electron–projectile terms can change it. The walk's SELECT proof checks that applying the extended operation to data with the correct sum gives the same result as applying the original operation and then computing the output sum.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.StoppingPowerSolution.InterWalkRSum42Hoist.E_stream42_eq_streamProjOp
lean.plain: Momentum sum from a zeroed register
lean.annotation: `E_stream42_eq_streamProjOp` identifies the forward sum computation on inputs whose sum register is zero. The initialization unitary can also be inverted on data carrying the correct sum. This supplies the operations used to clear the old sum and write the new one. Appendix G.3 describes their placement in the walk.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.stoppingPowerProgram
lean.plain: Circuit for evolution to t = j + 1
lean.annotation: The phase for translating all electrons by $-R_\ell$ depends on $P=\sum_i k_{p_i}$ because the individual plane-wave phases multiply. The same $P$ can therefore be used for the shifts at each proton. The master program receives `stream42ExtInitSpecBest_poly` to initialize the register holding this sum.

lean.name: QuantumComputation.Specs.StoppingPowerSolution.InterWalkRSum42Hoist.E_stream42_eq_streamProjOp
lean.plain: Momentum sum from a zeroed register
lean.annotation: In the internal two's-complement encoding, flipping the top bit of a six-bit component represents $p+32$. Each component sum is at most $218\cdot63=13{,}734<2^{14}$. `streamTarget42` stores the three sums in separate 14-bit fields. Subtracting $218\cdot32$ from each field recovers the sum of the integer momentum labels.

cuts the $T$ gates per step by $10\%$
statements.note: In the earlier real-space circuit, four sums of the 218 electron momenta accounted for about a fifth of the $T$ gates per walk step. The paper attributes the 10% reduction to halving the number of these sums. The 42-qubit register is included in the final logical width.
